#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Configuration
# ----------------------------------------------------- 
THEME="$HOME/.config/rofi/powermenu/powermenu.rasi"

# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Toggle Logic
# ----------------------------------------------------- 
if pgrep -f "rofi -dmenu -theme $THEME" > /dev/null; then
    pkill -f "rofi -dmenu -theme $THEME"
    exit 0
fi

# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Logic: Output options with specific icons
# ----------------------------------------------------- 
rofi_cmd() {
    rofi -dmenu \
        -theme "$THEME" \
        -p "Goodbye ${USER}" \
        -markup-rows \
        -theme-str 'configuration {show-icons: false;}' \
        -theme-str 'listview {columns: 5; lines: 1;}' \
        -theme-str 'element-text {horizontal-align: 0.5; font: "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font 32";}' \
        -theme-str 'window {width: 500px;}' \
        -theme-str 'inputbar {enabled: false;}'
}

# These are Nerd Font Glyphs. 
# They are just text, so they take the color of your theme text.
run_rofi() {
    echo -en "\n"
    echo -en "\n"
    echo -en "\n"
    echo -en "\n"
    echo -en "\n"
}

# Run Rofi and capture choice
chosen=$(run_rofi | rofi_cmd)

# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Actions
# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Note: We match the Glyph characters here, not the English words
case "$chosen" in
    "")
        hyprlock 
        ;;
    "")
        systemctl suspend
        ;;
    "")
        hyprctl dispatch exit
        ;;
    "")
        systemctl reboot
        ;;
    "")
        systemctl poweroff
        ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Configuration
# ----------------------------------------------------- 
THEME="$HOME/.config/rofi/powermenu/powermenu.rasi"

# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Toggle Logic
# ----------------------------------------------------- 
# Checks if this specific Rofi menu is running.

    rofi -dmenu \
        -theme "$THEME" \
        -p "Goodbye ${USER}" \
        -markup-rows
}

    echo -en "Lock\0icon\x1fsystem-lock-screen\n"
    echo -en "Suspend\0icon\x1fsystem-suspend\n"
    echo -en "Logout\0icon\x1fsystem-log-out\n"
    echo -en "Reboot\0icon\x1fsystem-reboot\n"
    echo -en "Shutdown\0icon\x1fsystem-shutdown\n"
}

    "Lock")

        ;;
    "Suspend")
        systemctl suspend
        ;;
    "Logout")
        hyprctl dispatch exit
        ;;
    "Reboot")
        systemctl reboot
        ;;
    "Shutdown")
        systemctl poweroff
        ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Config
CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/cliphist/thumbnails"
mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"

if pgrep -x "rofi" > /dev/null; then
    pkill -x rofi
    exit 0
fi

# Read cliphist
cliphist list | while read -r line; do
    id=$(echo "$line" | cut -f1)
    preview=$(echo "$line" | cut -f2-)

    if [[ "$preview" == "[[ binary data"* ]]; then
        img_path="$CACHE_DIR/$id.png"
        if [ ! -f "$img_path" ]; then
            cliphist decode "$id" | magick - -resize "500x" "$img_path"
        fi
        echo -en "$id\t[Image]\0icon\x1f$img_path\n"
    else
        # Escape backslashes for Rofi
        clean_text=$(echo "$preview" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g')
        echo -en "$id\t$clean_text\n"
    fi
done | rofi -dmenu \
    -p "Clipboard" \
    -display-columns 2 \
    -theme-str 'window {width: 800px;}' \
    -theme-str 'listview {columns: 1; lines: 6;}' \
    -theme-str 'element-icon {size: 4em;}' \
    | cut -f1 | cliphist decode | wl-copy
